integrity: Analytical semigroup and spectral argument supplied with reproducible 89-check standalone numerical/symbolic program; exact all-time claims do not rest on finite numerical testing.
scientific_limitations: The theorem controls complex-omega analyticity of the microscopic SEP normalized-gradient resolvent, not the physical lambda-plane. The eigenvalue at finite time is spectral rather than elementary. Applicability is confined to infinite symmetric exclusion with Bernoulli step data. The parent paper appendices were not fully accessible; novelty is qualified and independent priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: Sharp Bessel-zero law for the SEP current–density resolvent
